Deleting BOTH at once (done by hand in a spare throwaway copy, outside the campaign) still leaves lambert-multi-rev.test.mjs and grid-compute.test.mjs passing - the only two test files that execute this function. Read from the test: its boundary-case block accepts either a null result or all-non-converged branches, and its other M = 1 case has x squared well under the limit.
